9.anchor: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

16.anchor: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

3.anchor: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

13.anchor: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

11.anchor: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
